scope: Only conditional signed full-[0,1] boundary and affine-sweep scalar integration; no boundary validity, geometric approximation error, region/body, renderer or application acceptance.

policy.effective: Identical to requested policy; unsupported policy or excess stored degree/occurrence count refuses the request without truncation or clamps. Error cap must be finite and nonnegative.
policy.representative: Lower endpoint of adjacent-binary64 enclosure. Absolute error is the exact rational scalar minus that endpoint, rounded upward independently. No intermediate area or determinant rounding occurs before the exact sweep product.

independent_oracles: Owned Green-integral antiderivative fixture; exact Jacobian math polynomial.map.evaluate requests, responses and inspected schema provenance in decision.json
Polygon closed forms: square1, triangle1/2; open affine-line cross product -1/2; constant curve0
Generated degree1,2,4,8,16 x=t,y=t^n closed with diagonal: area1/2-1/(n+1)=(n-1)/(2(n+1))
Generated degree0..16 forward/reverse occurrence pairs cancel exactly; singular sweep and repeated-control cases are exact zero scalars

commands.note: Final production code. Three additional unit tests added during this run are covered by the subsequent final focused run.

ownership_determinism: Compile-time Send+Sync for all7 public types, standard owned report scalar fields and no unsafe implementation
Caller controls unchanged after success, failure and cancellation; later source edits and report cloning do not alter earlier report
Cancellation at every polled step of the representative complete sweep discards local work; subsequent request equals earlier result
Four threads each compute8 sweeps and compare exact report values with shared serial report
Two serial subprocesses and one parallel subprocess return byte-identical canonical enclosure/error-bit rows; probe invokes only current Rust unit-test executable
error_checks: Every fixture enclosure contains independent exact rational value
Upward error bound covers exact representative difference; predecessor binary64 bound is too small whenever nonzero
Underflow retains [0,minimum-subnormal] enclosure and nonzero error; huge boundary scalar is explicitly unrepresentable
Unrepresentable intermediate boundary scalar can yield representable sweep scalar through exact multiplication before any rounding
Typed incomplete failures retain requested policy, scalar operation, diagnostic occurrence index and original metric cause chain

sanitizer.interpretation: The previously built independent startup control was rerun during this task and again crashed before output. No host security change or ABI/runtime-check bypass was attempted. Successful language-enforced Send/Sync and deterministic stress are separate evidence.

exclusions: Rational weights, general nonpolynomial curves and trimmed/subinterval integration are unsupported; no curve substitution/fallback is performed
Coverage, closedness, non-self-intersection, orientation validity, support compatibility and sweep injectivity must be bound/proved by the consuming TKBO pipeline
No released accepted integral implementation existed for identical-workload previous-release performance comparison; no performance-regression claim
No live OCCT source or executable, no GPU, no Windows/macOS or32-bit target checks
No allocator-exhaustion simulation or process-level OOM recovery
